description: This file provides mock data for products used as fallbacks or for testing in a fashion retail frontend. It includes functions to retrieve a list of products, details for single products, and maintains a dataset with product attributes such as title, description, price, variants, and categories.

methods.name: getMockProductDetails()
methods.description: Returns an array of detailed mock product objects, each representing a product with attributes and variants.

methods.name: getMockProducts()
methods.description: Returns a simplified list of mock product objects conforming to the frontend API contract.

methods.name: getMockProductById(id)
methods.description: Returns a single mock product object matching the specified ID, used as a fallback for product detail pages.
